XML Source
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
<!-- Root element -->
<xs:element name="legoMOC">
<xs:complexType>
<xs:sequence>
<!-- productID -->
<xs:element name="productID" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
Unique identifier for each MOC (e.g., MOC-244792).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- name -->
<xs:element name="name" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>Name of the MOC assigned by the user.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- URL -->
<xs:element name="URL" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
Direct URL link to the MOC on Rebrickable (e.g., rebrickable.com/mocs/MOC-244096/).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- image -->
<xs:element maxOccurs="unbounded" name="image" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
Links to the representative images of the MOC. A maximum of 8 images can be provided.
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- releaseDate -->
<xs:element name="releaseDate" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:date">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
Date of release or upload of the MOC, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- size -->
<xs:element minOccurs="0" name="size" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/">
<xs:complexType>
<xs:sequence>
<xs:element name="width" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:decimal">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The width of the MOC when assembled.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="height" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:decimal">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The height of the MOC when assembled.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="depth" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:decimal">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The depth of the MOC when assembled.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
</xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
</xs:element>
<!-- category -->
<xs:element name="category" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
The category of the MOC (e.g., Vehicle, Building).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- keywords -->
<xs:element maxOccurs="8" minOccurs="0" name="keywords" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
Keywords describing the MOC (e.g., &#8220;Character&#8221;, &#8220;Ship&#8221;, &#8220;Empire&#8221;).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- audienceType -->
<xs:element minOccurs="0" name="audienceType" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
The target audience for which the MOC was designed: ["beginners", "intermediate", "experts"].
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- AggregateRating -->
<xs:element name="AggregateRating" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/">
<xs:complexType>
<xs:sequence>
<xs:element name="ratingCount" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:int">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The number of ratings received for the MOC.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="ratingValue" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:decimal">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The average rating value.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="bestRating" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The highest possible rating.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="worstRating" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The lowest possible rating.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
</xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
</xs:element>
<!-- isFunctional -->
<xs:element name="isFunctional" targetNamespace="https://yamz.net/" type="xs:boolean">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
Indicates whether the MOC has functional mechanisms (e.g., motors, gears, moving parts).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- altBuild -->
<xs:element name="altBuild" targetNamespace="https://yamz.net/" type="xs:boolean">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
Indicates whether the MOC is an alternate build (using parts from an official set).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- Offers -->
<xs:element name="Offers" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/">
<xs:complexType>
<xs:sequence>
<xs:element name="price" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:decimal">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The price of the MOC.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="priceCurrency" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The currency of the price.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
</xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
</xs:element>
<!-- piece -->
<xs:element minOccurs="0" name="piece" targetNamespace="https://yamz.net/">
<xs:complexType>
<xs:sequence>
<xs:element name="pieceType" targetNamespace="https://yamz.net/" type="xs:int">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The type of piece used in the MOC.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="pieceCount" targetNamespace="https://yamz.net/" type="xs:int">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The number of pieces of this type in the MOC.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
</xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
</xs:element>
<!-- downloadURL -->
<xs:element name="downloadURL" targetNamespace="https://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
The download URL for the instructions file (PDF or video).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- downloadCount -->
<xs:element name="downloadCount" targetNamespace="https://yamz.net/" type="xs:int">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
The total number of times the MOC has been downloaded.
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- mediaType -->
<xs:element name="mediaType" targetNamespace="https://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>
The media type of the instructions file (e.g., application/pdf, video/mp4).
</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- byteSize -->
<xs:element name="byteSize" targetNamespace="https://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#" type="xs:int">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The file size of the instructions in bytes.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<!-- Author Information -->
<xs:element name="Author" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/">
<xs:complexType>
<xs:sequence>
<xs:element name="Person" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/">
<xs:complexType>
<xs:sequence>
<xs:element name="name" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The name or nickname of the user.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="URL" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>The profile URL of the user.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0" name="follows" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>People the user follows.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0" name="owns" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>MOCs owned by the user.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0" name="inWishlist" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>MOCs saved in the user&#8217;s wishlist.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
<xs:element name="email" targetNamespace="https://schema.org/" type="xs:string">
<xs:annotation>
<xs:documentation>User's email address.</xs:documentation>
</xs:annotation>
</xs:element>
</xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
</xs:element>
</xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
</xs:element>
</xs:sequence>
</xs:complexType>
</xs:element>
</xs:schema>
